entries.description: Reported FAIL rather than 'passes two of three'. The pre-registration said all three or it is not a pass, written before the number existed, and nothing about that sentence was revisited once it cost something.

MY DEFECT: gl_test failed because I updated tb.v's module name and the Makefile source list but left the template's stock cocotb assertions testing an adder. The gate-level netlist is therefore UNVERIFIED against the golden model — reported as a real gap, not as a cosmetic CI failure.

findings.description: HARDEN 001 FAIL against pre-registered bars: fits 8 tiles (70.9% stdcell utilisation) and DRC/LVS clean, but setup timing FAILS at ss_100C_1v60 by -1.56ns. All three bars or it is not a pass.

CALIBRATION CONSTANT: placed stdcell area is 1.69x Yosys stat -liberty cell area (109,207 vs 64,593 um2), and the gap is mostly timing-repair buffers (1,084 cells, 10,658um2), hold buffers, CTS and taps — none of which synthesis-level stat can see. The project knew cell area was a lower bound; it did not know the factor.

INSTRUMENT GAP IN MY OWN PRE-REGISTRATION: the prediction claimed REQUIRED tiles but the run measured FIT AT A CHOSEN tile count, because info.yaml fixed tiles=4x2. The 5-7 prediction is UNSCORED — not passed, not failed. Finding the true minimum needs a sweep down through 3x2, 2x2.
